descriptions.text: Capture the spirit of Christmas with the Rustic Christmas Countdown Kit! This craft kit includes everything you need to make 25 individual paper envelopes to help you count down the days until Christmas. With beautiful paper greenery, bows, holiday flowers, gems, and more, you have all the supplies you need to create some unique envelope designs. Then, simply fill them up with a small treat or a sweet note! Whether you keep the kit for yourself or gift it to a friend, this advent calendar will add a charming touch to your home during the Christmas season. Kit includes: * Predesigned projects * Step-by-step instructions * Precut pieces (No prep work! Get right to crafting) * Makes 25 envelopes; 4" x 3" (10.2 x 7.6 cm) * Enough adhesive to complete projects * Precut Christmas die cuts * Twine * Embellishments * 25 wooden clothespins * A 9-7/8" x 6-1/2" x 2-3/4" (25.1 x 16.5 x 7 cm) printed designer box for storage or crafting on the go

descriptions.text: Looking for a way to show your hospitality? The Welcome Inn Paper Pumpkin Refill is all about creating elegant and sophisticated cards to invite, welcome, and thank guests and loved ones. With designs that work well with products from the Countryside Inn Suite, you can easily create gorgeous focal points on your cards using the precut vases and banners. Or you can keep things simple and elegant by adding some pretty embellishments. Whatever you decide to create, this refill kit will help you craft beautiful cards that any recipent is sure to appreciate. Refill includes: * 9 printed card bases: 3 each of 3 designs * Folded card size: 5-1/2" x 4-1/4" (14 x 10.8 cm) * 9 printed envelopes * Precut paper pieces * Adhesive-backed embellishments * Adhesive Product colors: Balmy Blue, Boho Blue, Calypso Coral, Daffodil Delight, Early Espresso, Misty Moonlight, Night of Navy, Old Olive.

descriptions.text: Transport yourself to a world of sun-soaked citrus, hand-painted ceramics, and enchanting greenery with the Mediterranean Blooms 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) Designer Series Paper. Inspired by the captivating beauty of the Mediterranean, it's the perfect choice for bright and colorful handmade cards, gift tags, packaging, and more. The tilework designs make great card backgrounds, and the blossoming lemons and oranges are a perfect way to add zest and lightness to your creations. Whether you're creating spring, summer, or Mediterranean-inspired crafts, the symphony of color and exquisite design of this paper will be appreciated by friends and loved ones.

Classic Stampin' Pads come in exclusive Stampin' Up! colors, grouped in collections to take the guesswork out of color coordination. Many of our other products come in the same exclusive colors, so it's easy to pair stamp pads with cardstock, markers, embellishments, and more! The innovative ink pad design has a patented flip-top lid to keep the stamp pad inked during storage. The firm foam pads outlast felt pads and give you a superior stamping experience.

descriptions.text: Soar among the clouds with the Take to the Sky Suite Collection! It's filled with aviation-themed stamps and dies, antiqued silver industrial embellishments, and crafting paper with topographical maps, blueprints, clouds, and complementary designs. Use it to create all-occasion, Father's Day, veteran, or adventure-themed cards, gift tags, paper packaging, and more. Die cut clouds and planes from the patterned paper or use the paper as a background to your creations. Design your own planes with stamps, dies, and embellishments, or keep things simple by pairing the paper with the included sentiments. Whatever you create, this suite can help your loved ones channel their inner pilot! Also available in French.

descriptions.text: Bring warmth and light to your home with the Home for the Holidays Paper Pumpkin Refill! This kit includes festive village scenes covered with soft blankets of snow, detailed precut Christmas trees, special glitter glue, and more. With inviting designs and holiday-themed sentiments, you can create Christmas cards that are sure to bring holiday cheer and joy to any loved one.

descriptions.text: Take your Christmas crafting even further this season with the Warm Wishes Cards & Envelopes Add-On! The simple and cozy vibe of the card bases make it easy to send warm Christmas wishes to friends and family. You can also customize your holiday cards with the stamped images and greetings from our current or past seasonal kits. Or take these beyond the season and use them however you like no matter the occasion!

The right stack shows deep red textured cardstock with a pink rectangular label area. Both appear to be pre-scored, folded card blanks in bulk quantities.

Two stacks of holiday greeting cards displayed side-by-side. The left stack features a winter night scene with snow-covered evergreen trees, a crescent moon, and stars on a navy blue background. The right stack shows solid red textured cards with a pink rectangular label area on the front. Both stacks are fanned to display the quantity of cards included.

descriptions.text: The Stampin’ Glass Mat Studio is a paper crafter’s dream! The heavy-duty glass mat comes printed with a ruler and grid lines for easy measuring, while the large surface space gives ample room for spreading out while paper crafting. The safety-tempered glass has a heat and scratch resistant surface that wipes clean with the included cloth and water—no chemicals needed. The reusable cloth also cleans ink off your stamps! The nonslip, heat resistant, waterproof silicone mat features four palette squares for mixing custom ink colors or for holding small ink spots in place while crafting. Each component can be used separately or you can use all three items together for a multipurpose paper crafting studio that’s both functional and elegant. The Stampin’ Glass Mat Studio includes: GLASS MAT * 5 mm thick * 17" x 14" (43.2 x 35.6 cm) * Safety-tempered * Heat and scratch resistant * Wipes clean with water or alcohol SILICONE MAT * 8-3/8" x 6" (21.3 x 15.2 cm) * Multiuse, nonslip
